no_incident_100_seed_investigation.interpretation: These alerts are false positives relative to the synthetic no-incident labels. Their patterns are random clusters that cross the configured thresholds; this does not establish whether similar patterns would be actionable in real merchant data.

limitations: All 100 datasets are synthetic and generated from the project demo-data generator.
Injected patterns are controlled examples, not representative merchant behavior.
Financial values are detector-associated amounts, not realised loss, recovered revenue, or causal estimates.
A case-level hit requires at least one finding of the expected injected type; extra alert types are counted and shown.
